lines.zh: 电流绕着我的腿，边走边响。
lines.en: Lightning coils around my legs, crackling as I walk.
My hair stands up and the wind bends around it.

lines.zh: 我一步踩下，地面焦了一圈。
lines.en: I set a foot down and the ground scorches.
This form is heavier than the last.

lines.zh: 空气在我身边噼啪作响。
lines.en: The air pops and snaps around me.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，是怕踩碎地。
lines.en: I walk slowly so I don't shatter the ground.

lines.zh: 头发被气顶着，不落下来。
lines.en: My ki holds my hair up; it never falls.

lines.zh: 我盯着前面的路，不左顾。
lines.en: I watch the road ahead and look nowhere else.
A trail of scorch marks follows behind me.

lines.zh: 每动一下，都有电光闪过。
lines.en: Every movement throws a flash of lightning.

lines.zh: 脚底的碎石，自己跳起来。
lines.en: The gravel under me leaps on its own.

lines.zh: 这个形态，走一步就够了。
lines.en: In this form, one step is enough.
I stand with lightning crawling between my fingers.

lines.zh: 头发垂不下来，被气托着。
lines.en: My hair can't fall; my ki holds it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢吐气，空气都在抖。
lines.en: I exhale slowly and the air trembles.

lines.zh: 眼里的东西，我自己都怕。
lines.en: What's in my eyes frightens even me.

lines.zh: 我握拳，骨节爆出一声脆响。
lines.en: I clench my fist and the knuckles crack.
The ground splits beside my feet.

lines.zh: 这一层的气，压得人喘不上。
lines.en: The pressure of this form steals the breath.
I'm letting it climb on its own.
A bird drops out of the tree.
The wind breaks when it reaches me.
I close my eyes a moment; the lightning still moves.

lines.zh: 我不用动，就已经在威吓。
lines.en: I don't have to move to be a threat.
The hair on my hands stands on end.
Above this, there's one more level.

lines.zh: 你离我这么近，还敢站着。
lines.en: You're this close and still standing.

lines.zh: 我的电，会先于我的手碰到你。
lines.en: My lightning reaches you before my hand does.
Get a good look at these eyes.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我可能已经不在了。
lines.en: Don't blink. I may already be gone.
Back away now and it's not too late.

lines.zh: 我能听见你的心跳，很快。
lines.en: I can hear your heartbeat. It's fast.

lines.zh: 这身气，压得你抬不起手。
lines.en: This ki of mine pins your arms down.

lines.zh: 你眼里的我，是不是在发光？
lines.en: Do I look like I'm glowing to you?

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，头发挡住了天。
lines.en: I raise my eyes and my hair blocks the sky.
Your ki is trembling. Don't pretend.
I'm not here to frighten you.
But take one more step, and I am.

lines.zh: 超级赛亚人二，气还在涨。
lines.en: Super Saiyan 2, and my ki still climbs.
Stand firm. I'm about to move.

lines.zh: 我的影子带电，你看地上。
lines.en: My shadow carries lightning. Look at the ground.

lines.zh: 你叫我什么名字，我都听得见。
lines.en: Whatever you call me, I'll hear it.

lines.zh: 这一层，不是为了对付你。
lines.en: This form isn't meant for you.
Don't come closer. I don't want to slip.
That hit made my lightning flicker.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，头发还竖着。
lines.en: I give half a step; my hair still stands.
Sparks jump wildly around the wound.

lines.zh: 这一下让电流闪了一下。
lines.en: That made my lightning flicker.
Blood falls on the scorched earth and smokes.
Fine. You have skill.
I wipe my lip and go again.
The hair around the wound is singed.
I steady myself, and the lightning brightens.
Hit me again and I go one level higher.
The lightning stops only when I sit down to eat.
Steam rises off this bowl of noodles.

lines.zh: 我吃一口，指间的电就弱一点。
lines.en: Each bite and the lightning in my fingers quiets.
This form burns through food fast.
Don't lean in; you'll get burned.
I cup the bowl carefully so I don't crush it.

lines.zh: 好吃。这样的东西不多了。
lines.en: Good. Food like this is rare.
Another bowl. I can still hold this form.
With a full stomach I can settle my ki.
I set the bowl down; my hair still stands.
You touched me and got a shock.
I pull my ki in a hair. Sorry.

lines.zh: 这一层的气，是会伤人的。
lines.en: The ki of this form does harm.
I step back to give you room.

lines.zh: 我的手碰到你，像碰到干柴。
lines.en: My hand on you is like touching dry wood.

lines.zh: 别从侧面撞，那里电最密。
lines.en: Not from the side; that's where the charge is thickest.
I lift my hand and the lightning follows.

lines.zh: 我们自己撞出的火花，落到草上。
lines.en: The sparks we strike fall on the grass.
You didn't retreat. That surprises me.
Stand steady first, then we'll talk.
In this form I don't dare touch anyone.

lines.zh: 我把气全收回去，才敢靠近。
lines.en: I pull all my ki in before I come close.
Only when my hair falls am I myself.
Some promises matter more than power.
I open my fist; my palm is hot.

lines.zh: 这个形态，不该用来做这个。
lines.en: This form was never meant for this.

lines.zh: 我把手放在她肩上，很轻。
lines.en: I lay my hand on her shoulder, very lightly.
She says she isn't afraid. I don't believe her.
The lightning dies down before I speak.

lines.zh: 这一层力量，换不来这些。
lines.en: No amount of this power can buy that.
I pinch it, afraid of using too much.

lines.zh: 手指带电，东西都粘上来。
lines.en: My fingers are charged; everything sticks to them.

lines.zh: 我把它放在掌心，慢慢收气。
lines.en: I hold it in my palm and slowly bank my ki.
Eating this will stretch my ki further.
I nearly crushed the bowl.

lines.zh: 我小心地拿，像拿一片叶子。
lines.en: I pick it up like a leaf.

lines.zh: 这点热量，还不够我一口。
lines.en: That much warmth isn't even a mouthful.

lines.zh: 我放进袖子里，电把它烫了。
lines.en: I tuck it in my sleeve; the charge scorches it.
Put it away before the lightning burns it.

lines.zh: 吃完我把手指按在地上。
lines.en: Afterward I press my fingers to the ground.
His ki jumped when my lightning touched it.
I raise my head, eyes full of light.
He can't run now.
From here it's half a breath.
I can hear his bones creak.
He shouldn't be standing there.

lines.zh: 我把气提起来，草全伏了。
lines.en: I raise my ki and the grass lies flat.

lines.zh: 我选了最直接的一条路。
lines.en: I take the most direct line.
The lightning arrives first, then me.
He's seen me. Then we begin.
I don't need to charge up.
In this form every blow is full strength.
My toes lift an inch off the ground.
My ki shoves the air aside.
He backs up; I follow in.
I don't like drawing things out.

lines.zh: 他动一下，我就到他前面。
lines.en: He moves once and I'm in front of him.

lines.zh: 残影留在原地，我已经走了。
lines.en: An afterimage stays behind; I'm already gone.

lines.zh: 残影还在原地，我已绕后
lines.en: The afterimage remains; I am already behind him.
I stop half a step behind him.

lines.zh: 电流先暴露了我的方向。
lines.en: The static gives my direction away.

lines.zh: 他的拳穿过了一道残影。
lines.en: His fist passes through an afterimage.
I use one hand at a time.
His breathing is getting heavier.
I'm waiting for his ki to fall.

lines.zh: 他每格挡一次，就退一点。
lines.en: Every block costs him an inch.

lines.zh: 我抬手，电在他脚边炸开。
lines.en: I raise a hand and lightning bursts at his feet.
He's retreating toward open ground.
I don't give him room to breathe.
In this form, speed is the pressure.

lines.zh: 我站定了，他还以为我在动。
lines.en: I've stopped, and he still thinks I'm moving.
His eyes have lost their focus.
One more and he's down.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，等他自己撞上来。
lines.en: I raise my hand and let him come.
Meteor combination, crashing down from above.
Every punch carries a charge.

lines.zh: 我一拳打穿了他的护甲。
lines.en: My fist punches through his armor.
In the air I land five kicks.
He blocked, and his palm is scorched.
I land and leave a ring of burnt earth.
That punch splits the air itself.
I missed, and the whole tree snapped.

lines.zh: 他抓住我的手腕，被电开了。
lines.en: He grabs my wrist and the charge throws him off.
One palm strike sends him flying.
I pin him and hold back the killing blow.
He's coughing blood; I don't stop.
I drop from above, trailing thunder.
In this form I can't rein the power in.

lines.zh: 我收手，让电慢慢熄下去。
lines.en: I stop and let the lightning fade.
I step back and the lightning fades.
Thunder sounds first; then I land.
My hair lifts strand by strand.
A scorched ring marks the ground.

lines.zh: 这一层的气，把云都推开。
lines.en: The pressure of this form pushes the clouds apart.
I open my eyes and lightning is inside them.

lines.zh: 空气里全是烧焦的味道。
lines.en: The air smells of scorched things.
The gravel at my feet lifts off the ground.
I flex my fists and the joints crack.

lines.zh: 升到这个形态，只用了半息。
lines.en: Rising to this form took half a breath.
Birds burst up in the distance.
The lightning at my fingertips lights my palm.
Lightning drips between my fingers.
Only a strong enemy brings me to this.
I breathe out and the grass goes down.

lines.zh: 天空闪了一下，那不是雷。
lines.en: The sky flashes once. That wasn't thunder.
I straighten, shoulders tight.
There's one more level. I won't use it yet.
Come on. Show me.

lines.zh: 火烧上来，我身上的电把它顶开。
lines.en: Fire climbs me and my charge shoves it off.

lines.zh: 我从高空坠下，砸出一道裂缝。
lines.en: I fall from high up and split the ground.
Underwater my own charge turns on me.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推出去，脚在地上犁出沟。
lines.en: The blast shoves me back, feet furrowing the dirt.

lines.zh: 一支箭射进我的肩，被电烧了。
lines.en: An arrow hits my shoulder and the charge burns it.
A foul force presses down on my ki.

lines.zh: 这个形态空着肚子撑不住。
lines.en: This form can't hold on an empty stomach.

lines.zh: 雷落在我头上，我接住了。
lines.en: Lightning falls on my head and I catch it.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，雷也追不上我。
lines.en: The ground is gone and even the thunder can't follow.
